name: Amy I. Muth
tagline: Top rated Criminal Defense attorney in Seattle, Washington
education: The Ohio State University Michael E. Moritz College of Law
about: Seattle, Washington, attorney Amy I. Muth, of Muth Atwood PLLC, is a seasoned and hard-working lawyer with years of experience defending clients accused of sexual misconduct.

A graduate of The Ohio State University Michael E. Moritz College of Law and the National Criminal Defense College, Ms. Muth has amassed an impressive track record of results on behalf of her clients. She is currently admitted to practice in Washington State, the U.S. Court of Appeals for the 9th Circuit, and the U.S. District Court for the Western District of Washington.

A dedicated professional, Ms. Muth is actively involved in several organizations, including the Washington Defender Association and the Washington Association of Criminal Defense Lawyers. She previously served on the board of directors of the Washington Appellate Project and the ACLU-WA legal committee and is a past president of the Washington Association of Criminal Defense Lawyers. Ms. Muth was also appointed by the Chief Justice of the Washington State Supreme Court as the chair of the Adult Offender subcommittee of the Court Recovery Task Force in response to the COVID-19 pandemic.

Her knowledge and experience have provided Ms. Muth with the opportunity to speak at numerous professional events. She is a past featured speaker at the National Association of Criminal Defense Lawyers’ sex crimes conference. Ms. Muth also frequently conducts trainings for professional organizations, public defender offices, sex offender treatment providers, investigators, and judges.

Ms. Muth is a past recipient of the President’s Award from WDA and from WACDL in recognition for her advocacy efforts on behalf of the criminal defense bar and her clients. In addition, she is regularly asked to write amicus briefs on sex offense issues for WACDL, WDA, and ACLU-WA for cases pending in the Washington State Supreme Court.
